tasks.title: Architecture & Directory Refactoring
tasks.why: Centralized monolithic settings and legacy script names caused high token waste and maintenance overhead
tasks.resolution: Modularized settings into src/config/ domain modules, streamlined src/daily/ scripts to collect/predict/archive, and symmetrically aligned tests/ directory
tasks.impact: Enhanced code maintainability, scalability, and AI-agent token efficiency with symmetrical test discovery

tasks.title: Daily Data Pipeline Refactoring & CSV Storage Standardization
tasks.why: Legacy heuristic judgment logic in collect_data & predict_position and inefficient excel openpyxl serialization
tasks.resolution: Refactored collect_data & predict_position with single-pass scenario priority logic, standardized UTF-8-sig CSV export with fixed 26-column order
tasks.impact: Improved prediction speed, eliminated duplicate API calls, guaranteed seamless spreadsheet copy-paste workflow

tasks.title: Daily Prediction & Dynamic Sizing Pipeline Integration
tasks.why: Integrate trained ML ranker, quantile risk model and utility sizing engine into daily operational pipeline with model persistence and legacy cleanup
tasks.resolution: Refactored src/daily/predict_position.py, added save/load_model_artifacts & predict_daily_position_sizing in src/ml/sizing_engine.py, cleaned legacy GMM/static logic
tasks.impact: Fast 1-second inference from artifacts/models/ and automated risk-managed portfolio sizing for 15:20 daily snapshot

tasks.title: Quantile Risk Model & Dynamic Sizing Engine Implementation
Backtest Evaluation & 3-Way Baseline Comparison
tasks.why: Validate AI model predictions against selection_rank and equal-weight baselines with yearly breakdown
tasks.resolution: Implemented src/ml/backtest_evaluator.py and integration with model_pipeline
tasks.impact: Proved AI model superiority with Top-1 return +1.53% (vs +0.63% baseline) and Win Rate 62.9% across 10 years

tasks.title: Preprocessor Data Recovery & 33k Full Dataset Restoration
tasks.why: Fix string percent symbol cleaning in clean_column_names to prevent 92% net_return row loss
tasks.resolution: Implemented percent/comma string cleaning in src/processing/preprocessor.py clean_column_names
tasks.impact: Restored all 33,934 rows (100%) for ML training

tasks.title: ML Model Selection & Purged Walk-Forward Pipeline
tasks.why: Establish zero-leakage Purged Group Walk-Forward CV and model evaluation
tasks.resolution: Implemented src/ml/purged_cv.py, src/ml/model_pipeline.py and unit tests
tasks.impact: Enables cross-validation, LightGBM ranking and backtest metric evaluation
